gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-malayalam: Sturdy, tall-lowercase words with a soft wobble in the stroke lead on Irish Grover, while Anek Malayalam stays tidy beneath. Its sans letters keep their curve tips apart.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-odia: Irish Grover is a chunky display face whose strokes shift only gently from thick to thin, giving its words a friendly, hand-shaped heft. And Anek Odia, a clean sans with unsealed rounds, keeps the text beneath it light.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anek-tamil: Fun and organic, with tall words and strokes that swell and ease off like a tide, Irish Grover takes the top. Anek Tamil's big round bowls make a plain sans text that flows easily.
gen-irish-grover-gf-anuphan: Irish Grover brings tall, sturdy lowercase and joins that taper modestly without ever vanishing, so headings feel playful and grounded. Anuphan follows in sans-serif, its big round bowls and clear curve gaps giving the page some quiet space.

gen-irish-grover-gf-armata: Chunky, playful and tall in the lowercase, Irish Grover shows a calm thick-thin shift across its open-throated letters. Armata, a plain sans with spacious gaps, would feel stretched if the body went large.
gen-irish-grover-gf-athiti: Tall lowercase makes Irish Grover look sturdy and big. Athiti is a sans-serif drawn at a single line weight with a high mean line and see-through s shapes, so a long passage reads smoothly and openly.
gen-irish-grover-gf-atkinson-hyperlegibl: Playful, with open-throated letters and a slight pinch where curves meet stems, Irish Grover is the organic one. Atkinson Hyperlegible, a sans with wide-set s terminals and clipped capitals, does the clear, steady text.

gen-irish-grover-gf-biryani: Biryani is a sans with a large clear eye on every e and counters that never clog, drawn with no thick-thin shift. And a long passage in it reads cleanly beneath Irish Grover's lightly modulated, sturdy headings.
